description: For agents with their own x402 wallet: pay an order from create_order, create_giftcard_order or create_esim_order directly in USDC instead of sending the person the payment link. Call it without payment to get the price (x402 PaymentRequired, valid 10 minutes), then again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Delivery starts as soon as the payment settles; follow it with get_order. Only for orders not paid through their link.
name: pay_order_x402
title: Pay an order yourself with x402 (USDC)
